metas.name: Madden
metas.description: John Madden's remarkable journey-from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with Al Davis and the Raiders, to creating Madden NFL, and becoming one of the most iconic voices in football history.

metas.name: Clashing Through the Snow
metas.description: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.

metas.name: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing
metas.description: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.

metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.

metas.name: Steps
metas.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

metas.name: Primetime Preacher$
metas.description: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

metas.name: Perfectos mentirosos
metas.description: Jude arrives at one of the most elite universities in the world and realizes that everything there revolves around an irresistible trio: the Cash Brothers. Jude plans to bring their darkest secrets to light... but just how innocen...

metas.name: Last Dinner
metas.description: The film focuses on what it means to truly love someone "in sickness and in health." In the story, talented pianist Canan embarks on a passionate affair with Bekir, a mysterious agent, after saving his life. However, Bekir suddenly disappears. When he returns years later, he finds Canan married someone else. This encounter rekindles a love that had been interrupted years before. Canan is forced to

metas.name: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
metas.description: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. metas.name: Expedition: Saving Our Seas
metas.description: Follows National Geographic Explorers investigating the global Ocean from seashore to seafloor as they chase discoveries and solutions needed to protect the seas amid rapid environmental change.

metas.name: Being Heumann
metas.description: In 1977, disability rights activist Judy Heumann leads a historic 28-day occupation of San Francisco's Federal Building, uniting protesters in a fight for accessibility laws and equal rights.

metas.name: Heartland
metas.description: Former country star Misty Jones leaves seclusion to search for her missing niece, an emerging musician, in Nashville. Her investigation exposes dark secrets and forces her to face her own past.

metas.name: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
metas.description: The Peanuts kids are on their best behavior — but Snoopy has landed on Santa's naughty list. With just 12 days until Christmas, he sets out to prove he's not such a bad beagle after all, discovering along the way that the season i...

metas.name: Russell Brand: Open Secret
metas.description: From comedy stardom to a criminal trial, inside voices and archive footage charts British comedian Russell Brand's meteoric rise and steep fall following allegations of sexual offences.

metas.name: Bara till jul
metas.description: מתילדה היא בחורה ביתית שמעולם לא עזבה את הכפר הקטן שבו גדלה, ופרדי היא בחורה עירונית שעובדת קשה ומבלה בהתאם. כמה שבועות לפני חג המולד, תפנית לא צפויה מאלצת את שתי האחיות להתחלף בחיים. כל אחת מוצאת את עצמה בעולם של השנייה, מול אתגרים שלא הכירה, ובדרך היא בוחנת מחדש את הבחירות שעשתה ומוצאת אהבה במקום שבו לא חיפשה אותה.

metas.name: The Gospel of Christmas
metas.description: A pastor faces doubt while trying to save his inherited family church in a troubled NYC area. Through faith and prayer, he fights inner demons and an enemy to protect his church, family, and community before Christmas.

metas.name: The Unthinkable Daughter
metas.description: Decades of questions and a crime that shook Brazil. Suzane von Richthofen, convicted for the murder of her parents, tells the whole story in her own words.

metas.name: Janelle James: How Romantic
metas.description: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

metas.name: Raise the Red Lantern
metas.description: A young woman becomes the fourth concubine of a wealthy man and soon realizes there's fierce competition for his attention and the associated privileges.

metas.name: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

metas.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Cautious 40-year-old Yui Katakura gets a cancer diagnosis with one year to live, transforming her outlook. She meets Sena, a broke pink-haired host, pays 720,000 yen for his company, and their unusual bond evolves into unexpected ...

metas.name: On Behalf of My Son
metas.description: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

metas.name: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
metas.description: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

metas.name: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
metas.description: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

metas.name: Overacting
metas.description: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

metas.name: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
metas.description: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

metas.name: Model Citizen
metas.description: A man awakes from a coma to find that his well-being is now the responsibility of an avatar provided by the government.

metas.name: Apocalypse Z: New World
metas.description: A supply mission to virus-ravaged Spain turns complex when Roberto, from the safe Canary Islands, joins with secret intentions. The team confronts infected masses and trust issues while weighing survival against humanity.

metas.name: The Mongoose
metas.description: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350

metas.name: When a Witness Recants
metas.description: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

metas.name: The Birthday​ Gift​
metas.description: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

metas.name: You, Me, Us
metas.description: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

metas.name: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
metas.description: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

metas.name: Drive - The Pretenders
metas.description: A young race car mechanic pretends to be engaged to the most scandalous racing star in the scene - officially for his reputation, but secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. Soon the lie threatens to destroy everything.

metas.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
metas.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

metas.name: Surviving Hurricane Otis
metas.description: In the middle of the sea, Wirpul and his half-brother Candi fight for survival when an unexpected storm turns into Hurricane Otis, a category 5 hurricane, off the coast of Acapulco.

metas.name: Ghooskhor Pandat
metas.description: A corrupt police officer's plans for a profitable night are disrupted when he discovers a severely injured girl abandoned from a moving car in Delhi, leading him into an international conspiracy.

metas.name: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
metas.description: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: Follows journalist Mariana van Zeller as she goes undercover as a romance scam target to expose a $1 billion criminal industry, teaming with a cyber hacker to confront a scammer posing as a four-star general.

metas.name: Sense and Sensibility
metas.description: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen's iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

metas.name: Street Fighter
metas.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
metas.description: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

metas.name: Seriously Single Too
metas.description: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

metas.name: Love of Your Life
metas.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

metas.name: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal
metas.description: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.

metas.name: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
metas.description: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

metas.name: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
metas.description: Instadocs investigates the Hugging Face attack and why this cyberattack may be a warning for humanity's future.

metas.name: Clown Panic
metas.description: In 2016, South Carolina children spotted clowns in woods. Reports spread across America, causing lockdowns and probes. Using archival content, and interviews, examines how fear and social media transformed a strange myth into hysteria.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

metas.name: The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: Other Mommy
metas.description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity which comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

metas.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
metas.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

metas.name: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
metas.description: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

metas.name: Reporting Live
metas.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

metas.name: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
metas.description: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

metas.name: Lo dejamos acá
metas.description: A renowned psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional therapy, begins to secretly intervene in his patients' lives, achieving remarkable results - until a creatively blocked writer enters his practice.

metas.name: Who Is Martin Mull?
metas.description: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

metas.name: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
metas.description: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

metas.name: Doing Life
metas.description: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

metas.name: Schumacher '94: The Birth of a Legend
metas.description: Follows 25-year-old Michael Schumacher's breakthrough 1994 Formula 1 season, featuring his first Grand Prix win in Brazil and the dramatic events of one of F1's most exciting racing seasons, including Ayrton Senna's accident.

metas.name: Verity
metas.description: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to...

metas.name: Digger
metas.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

metas.name: Infirmary
metas.description: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

metas.name: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
metas.description: A wealthy family loses their fortune and chooses to continue to fake affluence in an effort to keep up appearances.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: Two decades after "The Swan" shocked audiences, the women who underwent extreme makeovers and the show's creators reunite to examine the reality series that transformed their lives and sparked debate about beauty standards in Amer...

metas.name: Sam Morril: Incorrect
metas.description: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

metas.name: Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces veteran James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: The Florist
metas.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

metas.name: One Last Shot
metas.description: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

metas.name: Less of a Stranger
metas.description: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.

metas.name: Best of the Best
metas.description: A raucous comedy set in the cut-throat world of collegiate Bollywood dance competitions.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: Bad Apples
metas.description: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: You+Me - Against the World
metas.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy...

metas.name: Lust Stories 3
metas.description: Multiple narratives delve into contemporary relationships, portraying desire in its many forms while examining how vulnerability and unspoken tensions influence the ways people connect.

metas.name: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
metas.description: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

metas.name: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
metas.description: When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

metas.name: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
metas.description: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

metas.name: The Uprising
metas.description: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

metas.name: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: Runner
metas.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

metas.name: Gracias, equipo
metas.description: Tío Mochales, a company that, years ago, was the undisputed queen of Spanish cheese. Today, it's a somewhat rusty business trying to keep up appearances. Their latest big idea: to organise a rural team-building retreat in the vill...

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Call My Agent! The Movie
metas.description: Follows a former talent agent turned aspiring director who must reunite with her old team when her lead actor drops out days before filming begins.

metas.name: The Train
metas.description: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limit

metas.name: Drawn Together
metas.description: After her mysterious kidnapping in NYC, Spanish tycoon's daughter Marfil Cortés gets bodyguard Sebastián Moore. Despite clashing personalities, attraction grows as they face escalating threats in Spain, where appearances deceive.

metas.name: Why Did I Get Married Again?
metas.description: Jasmine loves Wesley, and their wedding is near - but her stern father and others disapprove, prompting couples around them to question their own "perfect" marriages.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

metas.name: Mayday
metas.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

metas.name: Onslaught
metas.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
